mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) inhibits monoamine oxidase, preventing codeine metabolism and increasing serotonergic activity, risking serotonin syndrome; codeine also has CNS depressant effects that are potentiated.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if codeine is necessary, use lowest dose with close monitoring for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, hyperthermia, rigidity, altered mental status) and respiratory depression.
